messages:
Ashley: heads-up — saw a spike of structured-output validation rejects on the routing node this morning. looks correlated with high queue depth on the tool adapter. sending logs shortly. :frowning:
Raj: ugh. which route? the payment-tool or the async-bridge?
Ashley: payment-tool primarily, but a few hits on async-bridge too. pattern: partial JSON payloads (truncated arrays) -> schema validator marks as reject -> fallback to text route which increases downstream cost.
Ben: can you paste a sample log line?
Ashley: sure. from adapter-7: ```ERROR validation: body truncated, expected 'items' array end; len=1024, read=856\nroute=payment-tool\nevent_id=evt_7f8c```
Sarah: that looks like backpressure causing the adapter to cut streaming chunks. we've seen similar when batching spikes and continuous-batching timeouts line up.
Raj: do we have a metric for "validation_rejects_by_route"? i only see global counts in the console.
Ben: not per route, AFAIK. console only surfaces a bucket for structured_rejects and a top-10 routes table but it's sampled and delayed.
Ashley: proposal: add a realtime tag for reject_reason and route_id to the validation telemetry and a small heatmap in the console (last 1h, 6h). also emit an adapter-level 'partial-stream' counter.
Sarah: agree. also we should differentiate hard schema mismatch vs truncated streams — both look identical to the validator right now.
Raj: short-term mitigation: can we make the validator tolerate trailing partial arrays if the adapter indicates a streaming-close? maybe a soft-accept that triggers a retry to the same model variant instead of falling back.
Ben: risky — we could accept corrupted payloads. but we could do a conservative soft-accept that flags the response as 'partial' and tags for a replay async job.
Ashley: alternative: on adapter detect 'stream-closed-midframe' emit an explicit error-code so the router can route to a retry path instead of the text fallback. much smaller surface change.
Sarah: that sounds better. router config change: add a policy to prefer retry-on-partial when retry budget > 0 and route isn't latency-critical.
Raj: dashboard needs a toggle so SRE can flip the policy per-environment. can we wire this into the rollout UI (canary -> 25% -> 100%)?
Ben: yes, but need telemetry to verify: success rate after retry, extra token cost, latency delta. console should show those before / during rollout.
Ashley: I'll open a tiny RFC. For now, ops: @Raj can you add the adapter partial-stream counter and an explicit error-code? @Ben can you add a sampled per-route reject reason tag into validation telemetry so we can patch the dashboard quickly?
Raj: on it. deploying a small agent now. deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-22T15:06:00Z - adapter-7 partial-stream-patch -> staged.
Ben: i'll add the telemetry flag and a dashboard tile (1h heatmap + per-route table). will push to console-staging.
Sarah: tagging ux: add an explanation/help text for "partial stream" behavior and recommended action during rollouts.
Ashley: thanks all. follow-up: once telemetry is live we'll run a 6h sample and decide whether soft-accept retry policy is safe to roll. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary complete: adapter-7 patch healthy on 3/3 hosts. metrics will appear in ~30s.
thread_summary: Discussion about structured output validation rejects caused by adapter backpressure. Action items: emit partial-stream error-code, add per-route validation telemetry and dashboard tile, consider retry policy vs soft-accept, and deploy canary patch.
